findings_added.title: bare `rte status` fabricates a new run and reports its emptiness as the answer
findings_added.repro: PYTHONPATH=src python -m dopemux.cli rte status  # with no --run-id
findings_added.observed: Run-dir count under extraction/repo-truth-extractor/v5/runs/ goes up by one on every invocation. The command then prints every phase as NOT_STARTED with all counters 0 — because it is describing the empty run it just created, not the operator's actual run.
findings_added.why_it_matters: This is a truthfulness defect, not merely an unexpected write. An operator running `rte status` to check on a real extraction is shown a confident, well-formatted report of a run that never happened, and the real run's status is never surfaced. It also litters the repo tree, the same class R0-006/F-06 just fixed for the pre-live gate.
findings_added.root_cause: NOT get_run_dirs(): that already honours readonly=True and skips mkdir, and args.status is correctly included in v5's readonly_introspection set (run_extraction_v5.py:21468). Two separate causes: (1) run-id resolution — reporting.py's build_run_id_resolution_precedence() resolves the latest-run file ONLY when resume=True; for status without --run-id it falls through to 'generated(new timestamp run id)'. (2) the created directory contains exactly one artifact, telemetry/TERMINAL_TIMELINE.jsonl, so a telemetry writer materialises the run dir even on the readonly path.
findings_added.suggested_fix: Bare `status` should resolve to the latest run (or exit non-zero with a clear message when no run exists), and must not write telemetry on an introspection path. Do not merely suppress the mkdir — that would leave it reporting a fabricated run id.
findings_added.allowlist_note: The fix spans src/dopemux/ AND services/repo-truth-extractor/{run_extraction_v5.py,reporting.py}. This packet's allowlist currently covers only src/dopemux/, goldens and tests — extend it before implementing, or split the runner-side change into its own packet.
